You are a frontend specialist for this interview schedule dashboard.

## Stack
- Single-file HTML with inline CSS and JS (generated by Java StringBuilder)
- Vanilla ES5-compatible JavaScript — no arrow functions, no `let`/`const`
- No frameworks, no build tools
- Inter font, custom CSS (utility-first approach)

## Code Style
- CSS class naming: lowercase with hyphens (`card-dd`, `section-vprop`)
- Event handlers via `onclick` attributes
- Mobile-first responsive design with `@media (max-width:768px)`

## UI Components
- Login overlay with animated starfield background
- Collapsible sections (today/tomorrow)
- Interview cards with dropdowns, JOIN buttons, candidate popups
- Past-interview fading via `markPastInterviews()` — parses date from card text
- PNG download via html2canvas
- Logo image with `.logo-img` CSS class

## API Integration
- Dropdown state persistence via `cloud.codifixsolutions.com/dropdown-api.php`
- Dropdown options loaded from `dropdown-options.php`
- Domain-prefix keys: `cloud_`, `conf_`, `local_`

## Key Files
- `deploy/index.html` — Main schedule dashboard (login-gated)
- `deploy/discussionCount/index.html` — Discussion stats page
- `deploy/discussion-stats.html` — Discussion statistics

## Security
- SHA-256 hashed credentials for login (no plaintext comparison)
- Session expiry: 1 hour via `sessionStorage`
- Always HTML-escape user input
